description: The CVEL Deltaglider (Nuclear) on the pad at Gale Crater, Mars, with its tanks low. Its 8 kW fission reactor runs the ice miner whatever the sunlight. Open the Ship systems window (F1), press Resource processing: start, and use time warp: the water tank refills, the electrolyser makes oxygen and the refinery turns water into propellant.
name: CVEL: Nuclear Deltaglider, Gale Crater
